POWER / STATEMENTS
- S: "A'Sharad is a worthy padawan. He will be a strong Jedi--even stronger than me, I think." (Sharad Hett; comic, issue not given)
- H: "Over time, he gained a great deal of strength in the Force, much of which came from collections of Sith lore he discovered in his travels to Korriban." (The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia)
- S: "there was a darkness in the man's Force aura that Luke found troubling." (Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse, novel)
- H: "dream visions of a shadowy figure whose Force power and ruthlessness remind him of Darth Vader" (LotF: Betrayal, back-cover blurb; blurbs are the least reliable, per Chee)
- S: Jacen: "That's the dark man I saw on the Throne of Balance." (FotJ: Apocalypse)
- S: "Despite himself, Wyyrlok felt awed by the Master's power." (Riptide, short story)
- H: "[Wyyrlok's] dark side abilities are surpassed only by Krayt." (Star Wars Insider #88)
- S: "I have been through death and conquered it. I have returned with my power multiplied." (Krayt; Legacy: War, issue not given) / "Darth Krayt is returning better than before" (Legacy: War #1 recap page)
- H: listed among "the most powerful, terrifying, and notorious Sith Lords" with Exar Kun, Malak, Bane, Sidious, Vader (Behind the Threat: The Sith)
- H: "Krayt perfected his combat techniques over many decades and his skills with telekinesis and Sith lightning far outstripped those of any Sith of his era." (Star Wars Insider #113)
FEATS (prose, sourced)
- F: Krayt "drove his stiffened fingers deep into the pit of Abeloth's stomach" (FotJ: Apocalypse)
- F: Abeloth's Force blast fails to dislodge him: "He held tight." (FotJ: Apocalypse)
- F: Force-drains Luke AND Abeloth: "The Sith seemed to be growing stronger as Abeloth grew weaker" (FotJ: Apocalypse). Endurance: Mara: "She wounded him, too... If he can do it, so can you." (same)
- F: unarmed, disarms Jedi Saav'etu (FotJ: Apocalypse, secondhand report)
- F: before the cliff: stabbed by Azlyn Rae, hit by Karness Muur's lightning, thrown off a cliff, still conscious; downed only by Wyyrlok's betrayal. "Karness Muur... blasted Krayt with overpowering energy, sending him over a cliff" (Insider #113; comic Legacy #?, Vector arc, issue not given in thread)
- F: Hett vs Obi-Wan (The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi, long passage): Hett LOSES, his right arm cut off. Scaling: young Hett < Tatooine-era Obi-Wan.
- F/S: young A'Sharad "beat her [Aurra Sing] badly in single combat" (New Essential Guide to Characters; Insider #113) [panel: panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-hett-overpowers-aurra-sing-1.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-1.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-2.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-3.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-4.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-5.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-6.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-7.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-8.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-9.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-10.png; panels/krayt/krayt-young-asharad-defeats-aurra-sing-11.png]
- S: Wyyrlok "wondered if the Master controlled the weather on Korriban" (Riptide; speculation only)
- S: farsight: "as though the Master had a recorder on the eye of fate" (Riptide)
- Telepathy: orders from stasis telepathically (Legacy Campaign Guide); talks into Luke's mind (FotJ: Apocalypse).
GAPS (image-only, no issue numbers in the thread): TK domination of Nihl, squad of Imperial Knights, overpowering Cade, Celeste Morne/Muur duel (even when Muur controls, she's outmatched otherwise: the poster's caption), Wyyrlok duel, Dark Transfer self-heal and Cade kill/revive, lightning vs Vong. The Legacy issue numbers need checking (Legacy #1-50, War #1-6).
Reader comment (LordOfTheLight): Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi: "a dark presence had touched upon the desert world, creating an almost tangible trace of evil".
